newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Moscow region issues $173 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Russia Moscow region issues $173 mln bond.

text.p: Russia's Moscow region has issued one trillion roubles ($173 million) of fixed coupon bearing bonds, Russian Unikombank said in a statement on Monday.
The bonds were issued in a closed subscription on June 20. The issue was organised by a group of banks headed by Unikombank, which is also acting as a paying agent, and CS First Boston.
The issue consists of an 18-month tranche and a two-year tranche, each with a 20 percent coupon payable semi-annually, it said.
An issue prospectus for two tranches of 500 billion roubles maturing on December 10, 1998 and June 10, 1999, respectively, was registered by the Ministry of Finance of Russia on June 18.
Trade in the bonds would begin on July 1 on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), where the bonds are registered and which is the depository and settlement centre for them.
The first interest payment for both tranches of the paperless state securities with one million rouble nominal value is due on December 10, 1997.
